purpose: The Fraud Scoring Service evaluates every payment in near real time and writes a decision: allow, review, or block.

components.name: payment-events (MSK)
components.evidence: input topic, one event for every payment with the customer attributes.

components.name: scoring-engine
components.evidence: the service which read the events, calculate the score and write the decision.

components.name: scoring audit log group
components.evidence: the place in CloudWatch where audit records are written.

flows.evidence: First, payment-events send the payment event to the scoring-engine.
Second, the scoring-engine write the risk decision to decisions-db.
Third, the scoring-engine write an audit record to the scoring audit log group.
